verdict.rationale: USPTO is a government patent and trademark filing and search service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or assistant surface that could use external tools; the API and developer-portal probes only show machine endpoints USPTO serves to others.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
